protocol.latent_selector: History visible latent>=2 same-link defines ongoing; else onset. Latent queue required in horizon; onset first occurrence T+30; latent persistence IoU<=.9; history quality>=.7.
protocol.observation_subset: Within the same latent-selected events, require observed eligible future positive, onset first observed at T+30, and observed persistence IoU<=.9
protocol.prediction: Two fixed baselines see only thirteen noisy past/current slots and history quality. No future quality/latent inputs.
protocol.scores: Known latent and noisy-threshold labels scored after predictions, same future eligible mask. Separate all-latent-selected versus observation-subset populations.
protocol.sampling_limit: All qualifying five-minute origins overlap; scene/seed is the evidence unit, no per-origin independent CI
